messages.warning: No PR k_ij for Hydrogen + Water: k_ij = 0 used; results for this pair are a prediction without binary data.

PR is the method here: Hydrogen, Carbon dioxide are light gases, which only an equation of state describes (gas-phase reactors and high-pressure loops are simulated so). For a liquid of the polar components alone (Water) below about 10 bar, such as their distillation, an activity model (NRTL or UNIQUAC) would be more accurate (docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md).
